title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks reused by every contract. Timestamps use a regex instead of `format` so validators can be compiled to standalone code for n8n Code nodes.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, e.g. 2026-10-17T09:30:00Z or with milliseconds.

job_id.description: Short slug for a role, e.g. csr, sdr, admin.

code.description: Machine-readable reason or flag code, e.g. NO_SHIFT_AVAILABILITY.

candidate_status.description: Candidate state machine (D-018). ADVANCED and REJECTED are human-only final decisions; automation can never set them.

evidence_quote.description: A verbatim excerpt from the CV. Code checks that it really appears there.
